title: Available product information settings in Upgraded Smart+ Campaigns
content_data:
The availability of the "product information" feature in Upgraded Smart+ Campaigns, configured via the `product_info` parameter, depends on various campaign settings. The following tables outline the scenarios where `product_info` can be used to enable the "product information" feature via the [/smart_plus/ad/create/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1843317390059522) or [/smart_plus/ad/update/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1843317411665921) endpoint. ## For App Promotion ads

seo_title: TikTok product info in Upgraded Smart+ Campaigns via API
seo_description: Learn about the "product information" feature that can be configured via the product_info parameter.  Its availability depends on various campaign settings.
